description: This file contains unit tests for profiling tools, including tests for default profiler selection and output, as well as parsing of pprof output. It defines test classes for ProfilerFactory and GooglePProf.

classes.name: ProfilerFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ProfilerFactory, testing default profiler selection and output path creation.

classes.name: GooglePProfTest
classes.description: Unit test class for GooglePProf, testing parsing of profile output.

methods.name: _assert_default_profiler_name
methods.description: Asserts that the default profiler name matches expected for a given OS name.

methods.name: test_default_profilers
methods.description: Tests default profiler names for various OS types.

methods.name: test_default_profiler_output
methods.description: Tests that the profiler creates the correct output path based on the host OS.

methods.name: test_pprof_output_regexp
methods.description: Tests that the first ten lines of a pprof profile output are correctly extracted.
